F0.label: original full fast stack (historical control)
F0.note: must never be selected, re-built, or re-qualified

performance_thresholds_speedup_vs_R0.note: null = no candidate is applicable (zero hub-kernel sites); these models always use R0

selection_rule.step_1: eligible set = candidates passing numerical equivalence AND repeatability AND performance threshold AND memory
selection_rule.step_2_if_eligible_set_empty: select R0; record status NO_QUALIFIED_ACCELERATION (not a scientific model failure)
selection_rule.step_4_if_multiple_eligible: select the highest median synthetic rows/sec
selection_rule.step_5_tie_break: if the fastest two are within 5% of each other, select the smaller dependency set (C1 preferred over C2, C2 over C3)
selection_rule.step_6_reference_preference: R0 is never displaced by a candidate that fails any gate; a numerically ineligible candidate is never selected even if it is faster

invariants: one and only one execution environment fingerprint per model, across ALL populations and ALL cells
no mixed environment within a single model
the original full-fast environment F0 remains rejected
the immutable thresholds are never relaxed
no study row is read, scored, or timed during selection
selection is operational only and makes no scientific claim

human_adjudications.subject: C2
effect: C2 is marked INELIGIBLE / DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY / NOT_SELECTABLE
C2 must not be benchmarked for adoption
C2 must not enter the selection set
